why: Before the amendment the notice deadline is 2043-12-02 (60 days before 31st January 2044), 48 days after 2043-10-15: alert. The signed amendment moves the expiry to 31st July 2044, so the deadline becomes 2044-06-01, far outside 60 days on 2043-10-20: the alert goes away.

controls.why: the extension moved the deadline to 2044-06-01
